title: AI-assisted aneurysm detection supports Sophia Chan's emergency treatment and recovery at Mayo Clinic
summary: Sophia Chan survived a ruptured aneurysm after AI-assisted diagnosis and emergency treatment at Mayo Clinic.
account: In February 2022, Sophia Chan became unresponsive after an aneurysm ruptured. At Mayo Clinic in Jacksonville, AI helped clinicians locate it within minutes. She underwent surgery, although her husband was initially told that she was unlikely to survive. After weeks of stabilization, she recovered. Mayo reports that she had resumed an active family life two years later.
system: AI analysis of brain CT images

ratings.reason: Chan survived a critical hemorrhage and regained an active life. Mayo credits AI with aiding diagnosis.

ai_role.statement: AI helped locate the aneurysm. Clinicians provided treatment. The software and its separate effect on survival are unspecified.

evidence.title: Transforming Stroke Care and Outcomes Using AI
evidence.quote: the AI algorithms that allowed the care team to find her aneurysm in minutes

produced_by: AI-assisted imaging, surgery, and intensive care.
must_hold: Timely imaging, clinical review, and access to emergency treatment.

fields.account: In February 2022, Sophia Chan became unresponsive after an aneurysm ruptured. At Mayo Clinic in Jacksonville, AI helped clinicians locate it within minutes. She underwent surgery, although her husband was initially told that she was unlikely to survive. After weeks of stabilization, she recovered. Mayo reports that she had resumed an active family life two years later.
